messages:
anya: Quick flag — ran the nightly fused-RoPE + Flash-paged attention smoke on dedicated-nyc pool and saw ~12% token latency regression vs last stable. KV cache warm scenario.

mike: yikes, any traces? did batching config change?

anya: no config changes AFAIK, same batching heuristics. attached profiler snippet in case:```
# top kernels by time
scaled_softmax_kv_flash        48.1%
kv_lookup_and_concat          18.3%
rotary_mul_fused_dim          12.7%
reduce_attn_output             7.9%
other                         13.0%
```

ricardo: rotary_mul_fused_dim jumped? previous runs had that at ~6-7%

anya: yep that's the odd one. I repro'd with single-request long context (8k) + warm cache. Perf-bot posted CI bench too:

perf-bot: nightly-bench/fused-rope-pagedflash/1965550000 => mean token latency 23.1ms (baseline 20.6ms) :warning: regression +12.1%

sophia: could be dimension-specific scaling hitting an unoptimized kernel path. Which rotary dim config did you use?

anya: model: redwood/xxl-rotary-16k, rotary dims set to full (d_rot = d_model). Also tried rotary scale variant = "v2-scale" which increases magnitude at high positions.

mike: did kernel selection fallback to a generic GEMM for that path? kernel selector logs?

anya: pasted selector excerpt:```
[kernel-selector] model=xxl-rotary-16k seq=8192 batch=1 hw=A100 paged=true fused_rope=true
selected_kernel: flash_paged_fused_rope_qkv_v3
fallbacks: []
notes: picked because memory footprint under threshold and latency estimate looked best
```

ricardo: hmm selector picked v3. v3 introduced an extra elementwise rotary multiply in CUDA which isn't fused with softmax. That could increase kernel launches and hurt warm-cache throughput.

anya: profiler shows extra launch overhead — nvprof trace: many small kernels around rotary phase.

mike: can you try forcing flash_paged_fused_rope_qkv_v2 (older variant) to see delta? quick A/B would tell if it's selector regression vs kernel regression.

anya: doing that now. running 5 warm/warm+1 cold samples.

infra-bot: reserved capacity autoscale note: dedicated-nyc pool at 72% GPU util during test window.

anya: quick results: v2 => mean token latency 20.9ms (close to baseline). v3 => 23.4ms. So v3 is the culprit.

ricardo: ok that's actionable. hypothesis: v3's rotary fusion assumes rotary dims <= 0.5*d_model for certain vectorization; when full rotary dims it's taking slow path. I'll add dimension-guard to kernel selector to avoid v3 for full-rotary configs and run microbenchmarks.

mike: also add a unit perf test that exercises warm KV cache + seq 8k + batch1 so we catch regressions.

anya: filed PERF-1197 and attached traces + repro script. tagging infra for extra CI runs. @sophia FYI for model onboarding implications.

perf-bot: created PERF-1197 with links to traces and nightly failure artifact.

sophia: thanks everyone. if ricardo wants quick help with vectorization checks I can pair.

ricardo: will take it. expected plan: revert selector for v3 on full-rotary dims, add unit, and fix fusion path in v3. target: patch next week.

anya: sweet. leaving logs and repro in the ticket. :thumbsup:
